original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the approved adult female character identity and clothing anchor. Reproduce this EXACT SAME fictional woman, preserving her specific facial geometry, eye shape/color, nose and lips, cheekbones, jaw, skin color, freckles/beauty marks, hairstyle/color, earrings, necklace and clothing. Do not redesign or beautify into another person. Premium consistent otome 2.5D/3D semi-realistic CG, detailed hair strands, luminous skin with subtle microtexture, fine cloth materials. Soft neutral bright studio light, solid pure WHITE background. Create ONE nine-panel facial expression sheet, exactly 1536x1536 SQUARE, precise 3 by 3 evenly spaced grid. SAME woman, hairstyle and outfit in ALL NINE cells, consistent head scale, eye-level frontal camera, head-and-shoulder crop. Each cell fully contains head and hair with white gutters. Nine distinct natural expressions, row-major: 1 neutral relaxed; 2 warm closed-mouth smile; 3 joyful open-mouth laugh with natural teeth; 4 surprise raised brows slightly open mouth; 5 thoughtful skeptical one raised eyebrow and pursed lips; 6 resolute anger lowered brows firm lips; 7 sadness moist eyes lowered mouth corners; 8 worried alert tense brows and slightly parted lips; 9 shy pleased subtle blush soft smile. Only facial muscles change, never face identity. No cartoon symbols, exaggerated deformation, text, labels, speech bubbles, hands or extra cells.
